subject: Blended-rate mapping + short-term volume hedge (post-demo)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Craig Marshall <craig@orbitlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 20:12:00 -0700
Subject: Blended-rate mapping + short-term volume hedge (post-demo)

Craig — thanks for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and concrete asks so we keep momentum: 

What we heard (Orbit priorities):
- Customer-facing chat and search: ~8–12M tokens/month initially, 20–30M in 6–9 months if the pilot goes well.
- Hard budget window for Q3: $40k–$60k/mo for inference (net) — procurement flexibility around term/PO.
- Must preserve 99th-pct latency < 350ms for chat peak.

Open items we need from you to finalize pricing scenarios:
1) Confirm the 6–9 month target: is 20M tokens/month your best-case?
2) Any hard constraints on per-1M token target price (e.g., target $/1M tokens)? You mentioned ~$1,200 as a goal on the call — please confirm.
3) Do you expect to route sensitive requests to a private deployment (VPC) or keep everything hosted? (affects Dedicated vs Hosted pricing)

What I'll do next:
- Send two blended-rate scenarios (monthly step-up and 12-month blended commit) and a short-term volume-hedge option (90-day buffer + promotional credit) for you and procurement to review.
- Attach the ROI table I mentioned and a sketch of routing options we discussed.

Attachments: Orbit_ROI_Table.xlsx (XLSX, 36KB); redwood_routing_diagram.png (PNG, 48KB)

Proposed next step: 15-min procurement-friendly walkthrough next week to agree the PO/term path. Are mornings PT on Tue/Wed ok?

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189
From: Craig Marshall <craig@orbitlabs.com>

Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Blended-rate mapping + short-term volume hedge (post-demo)

Thanks, Priya — good summary. Quick answers inline: 

1) 20M/month is our stretch target in 6–9 months; conservative plan is 15M/month.
2) Confirming target: we were aiming for ~$1,200 / 1M tokens for the bulk usage. For pilot, procurement expects to see an initial window at up to $1,500 / 1M but wants to see step-downs.
3) All traffic will stay on Redwood hosted for now; private/VPC is a 2028 consideration.

Procurement asks: can you show a simple 3-tier ladder (0–5M, 5–20M, 20M+) with blended per-1M outcomes and an example blended $/1M for a 12-month commit vs a 90-day hedge? Also we need estimated monthly spend for the pilot (expected 8–12M).

I’ll loop in contracting after we have a quick pricing matrix. Tue morning PT works.

— Craig
Craig Marshall
Head of Product, Orbit Labs
craig@orbitlabs.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Craig Marshall <craig@orbitlabs.com>, Procurement <procurement@orbitlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Blended-rate mapping + short-term volume hedge (post-demo)

Craig / team — thanks for the specifics. Per your ask, attached is a concise pricing matrix plus two scenarios: 12-month blended commit and a 90-day volume-hedge. Key highlights below. Full workbook attached.

Scenario A — 12-month blended commit (recommended if Orbit expects steady growth to 20M):
- Tiers: 0–5M @ $1,650 / 1M; 5–20M @ $1,200 / 1M; 20M+ @ $950 / 1M (step-downs applied monthly).
- Example blended outcome at steady 15M/month: blended $/1M ≈ $1,245; annualized spend ~ $224k/month equivalent.

Scenario B — 90-day volume-hedge (pilot 보호 / short-term cap):
- Short-term buffer: 3-month commitment at pilot volume (10M/mo) + 30% buffer capacity at a fixed $1,500 / 1M for overage protection.
- Promotional credit: one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of first-month billed tokens (applies if you sign a 6–12 month follow-on).

Routing note: since you'll stay hosted, assume standard hosted rates; private/VPC add-on pricing will be separate.

Ask from Orbit for finalization:
- Please confirm whether the pilot will target 8M or 12M monthly (we priced both in the workbook).
- If procurement is ok with the 12-month blended grid, I’ll put together an SOW + PO-ready estimate + redlined SOW for legal.

Attachments: Orbit_ROI_Table.xlsx (updated), pricing_matrix_ORBIT_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)

If Tue morning still works, I’ll reserve 08:30 PT for a 15-minute run-through with procurement.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 09:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Orbit pricing concession note

Priya / Aditya — quick internal note to support the deal close: 
- For Orbit, offer a one-time 15% bill credit applied across months 1–3 of the pilot if they sign a 6-month follow-on within 45 days of pilot end. This preserves unit economics but creates a short-term incentive.
- Approve a locked 90-day hedged rate at $1,500 / 1M for overages during the pilot.
- Legal: attach the redlined_SOW_v2.pdf for contracting; contracting can accept PO + SOW path.

I’ll be on the Tue 08:30 PT call to backstop the concession.

— Marissa
Director, Commercials
